entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Look, that building is where the Treasure[n]is! We're not far.

entries.en: If it's seriously that close, can't we just[n]go from outside? No point goin' through[n]there.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Hm... That might be worth a try.
